item.title: See how long you sleep on Health
item.summary: Health in Progress has a Sleep page again, and it leads with your usual night, like 7h 52m a night, with how much that's changed since you joined right under it.
item.details: The number is your average over your last 7 nights, the same place the chart's line ends. Hours slept still stay off Totals and medals. Coming with the next app update.
